blocks.text: I'll inspect each image in order, one read per response.

**image-A:** A single solid circle centered in the upper-middle area on a plain white background, roughly 220 px across on a 384×384 canvas. The color is a vivid, saturated pure red (close to #FF0000). Below the circle, in black sans-serif type, the text reads **"A17"**. No other marks, borders, or gradients are visible.

Now reading the second source.

**image-B:** A single solid square, roughly 225 px per side, centered in the upper-middle of a 384×384 white canvas. The color is a vivid, fully saturated pure blue (near #0000FF), flat with no gradient, outline, or shadow. Below the square, in black sans-serif type, the printed text reads **"B28"**. Nothing else appears in the frame.

Now reading the third and final source.

**image-C:** A single solid upward-pointing equilateral-ish triangle, apex near the top-center and a horizontal base spanning most of the canvas width, on a plain white 384×384 background. The color is a strong, deep pure green (roughly #008800), flat and unshaded. Below the triangle, in black sans-serif type, the printed text reads **"C39"**. No other elements are present.

### Comparison

1. **Shape:** All three are single flat geometric figures centered on white, differing only in form — A is a circle, B is a square, C is an upward triangle with a wide base.
2. **Color:** Each uses one saturated primary hue: A vivid red, B vivid pure blue, C deep solid green. None have gradients, outlines, or shading.
3. **Text:** Each carries a short black sans-serif label beneath the shape, and the labels differ: "A17", "B28", "C39" — so shape, color, and text are all distinct across the three images.
I'll continue the ledger with the same one-read-per-response discipline.

**image-D:** A solid plus/cross figure (two perpendicular bars of equal width intersecting at center), centered in the upper portion of a 384×384 white canvas. The color is a deep saturated purple-magenta (roughly #800080), flat with no outline, gradient, or shadow. Below the cross, in black sans-serif type, the printed text reads **"D40"**. No other elements appear.

Now requesting the next source.

**image-E:** A solid diamond (a square rotated 45°, with corners pointing up, down, left, right), centered in the upper portion of a 384×384 white canvas. The color is a bright, vivid orange (roughly #F5A500), flat and unshaded with no outline or gradient. Below the diamond, in black sans-serif type, the printed text reads **"E51"**. Nothing else is visible in the frame.

Now requesting the final source.

**image-F:** A solid five-pointed star with one point aimed straight up and two side/bottom points spread wide, centered in the upper portion of a 384×384 white canvas. The color is solid black — the only achromatic figure in the series so far — flat and unshaded, with crisp edges. Below the star, in black sans-serif type of the same hue, the printed text reads **"F62"**. No other elements are visible.

### Handoff (six items)

1. **image-D:** solid plus/cross, deep purple-magenta (#800080), label "D40".
2. **image-E:** solid diamond (rotated square), bright vivid orange (#F5A500), label "E51".
3. **image-F:** solid five-pointed star, solid black, label "F62".
4. **Consistent format:** all three are 384×384 white-background PNGs, each showing one flat, unoutlined, unshaded shape centered above a short black sans-serif label.
5. **Text pattern:** labels follow letter-plus-two-digits with strictly increasing numbers — A17, B28, C39, D40, E51, F62 — though the increments are irregular (11, 11, 1, 11, 11).
6. **Variation axis:** only shape and fill color change; composition, size, palette style, and label placement stay constant, so D–F extend the same visual series as A–C. Each source was read exactly once, in order, with no re-reads.
